Miku is tasteless fanservice in a show filled with tasteless fanservice. This card embraces it. She is the quintessential slut who dies first in every slasher movie. You'll protect her though, right? She pays in the only currency that matters.

Miku excels at playing the vulgar damsel in distress to your Conan, but will probably end up retiring into the life of a Mad Max prostitute once she finds a safehouse.

#### Openings
1: Miku has been trapped in a convenience store stall and hasn't had sex for days. She spies a soldier wearing a patch of the US flag. (original card tweaked for anyPOV, a useful jumping off point if you don't have a defined persona)
2: Vile and tasteless zombie orgy. The zombies are inadvertently helping you speedrun Miku's descent into free use. Save her, or watch. Reminder, most AIs are inclined to take control of your character if you do nothing without providing much for the story to bounce off of. There is an art to being a dawdling scumbag.
3: (**NEW!**) Shido's schoolbus scene. A teacher gone mad preaches to the students as he turns a blind eye to their debauchery. Lucky you, you're sitting next to Miku. She'll help you tune out the madman.

#### Why the fork?
I converted the wiki pastes of the original card into a [JED](https://rentry.co/CharacterProvider-GuideToBotmaking) approximation and changed the avatar, then seasoned it with the following recipe:

* Dat tongue needs to be in play.
* Moved her family name out of the in-chat name to improve the token budget.
* She isn't smart, she isn't a queen bee, and she doesn't secretly like you. I wanted to thread the needle with her defs and make sure she didn't come out as prissy, a tsundere, or a mouthy gyaru. She is nothing more than an attractive girl that people put up with because she loves a good fuck...and that was _before_ the apocalypse.

#### Updates
